name: iBerry Care
headline: Reliable iPhone service center Dubai
lede: Get expert iPhone repairs at iBerryCare, Dubai’s trusted Apple service center. From screen replacements to battery issues, we ensure fast and reliable solutions.
services: Trusted iPhone Service Center in Dubai
about: After 2 iPhones, i had now my iPad Air 2 repaired here. Excellent and fast service as usual. Battery needed to be replaced, and during this process, an issue with the charge-control module was found, which was also replaced. in all, after 40 minutes the job was done and everything works perfect again. Prices are very, very decent and affordable. I can surely recommend this shop.

I had never known iberrycare until I came across the search. very professional with guest especial the one in charge of delivering the phone and the service lady. I had to fix my note 8 screen now is perfectly okay but sometimes prices are way too much. thanks to iberrycare.
